note: Each estimate of the lemma has a Lean counterpart with lambda=e^n and Budget a meaning O(lambda^a); [L] states them for arbitrary profiles, widths and delta, with hypotheses on the words (Mixed, Own, Pressed) that encode 'projected collinear' and the sign pattern, and the diagonal estimate also under conservation of J. The 'delta=1' choices of [M] are instances.

theorem line_cost (H : S.Hierarchy) (l : Axis) (e : Axis→Bool) (A : Weight L) (hf : ∀ i, Own A i (e i))
    (he : Mixed (other l) e) (h : ∃ i∈other l,e i≠e l) (hp : ∀ j∈other l,Pressed j A)
    (i : Axis) (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ j,w j≤0) (δ q : ℝ) (hq : q<0) (hd : 0<δ) (f : Grouping)
    (hl : Colors Finset.univ f) :
    Budget (if i=l then δ else -w l+δ) (fun n => ∫ p,cost i Finset.univ (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by
